# Violin plot of a-diversity

## Load packages and functions

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
```

# Import taxonomic a-diversity dataset

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Alphadiversity/Data/Metadata_Irrigation.manipulative.exper.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data1 <- read.csv("./Alphadiversity/Data/Species_alpha_diversity_Rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data2 <- data1[rownames(design),]
data <- cbind(design, data2) # merge design and a-diversity
```


# Plot taxonomic alpha-diversity

```{r}
colors <- c("irrigated"="#4169B2", "non-irrigated"="#BB2BA0")
theme.plot <- theme(axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 17),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(colour= "black", size= 17, angle= 35, hjust = 1),
                    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 17),
                    legend.position = "NULL",
                    panel.border = element_rect(color="black", size=1),
                    panel.grid = element_blank())


## Shannon 
range(data$Shannon)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Shannon, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth=0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Shannon") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(7.51, 7.57), breaks =seq(7.51, 7.57, 0.02)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7.57, label = "P = 0.045", size = 6)

p1
ggsave("./Alphadiversity/Output/Shannon_taxonomic.pdf", p1, width = 3.5, height = 4)

# Statistical analysis
anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data))


# Observed species
range(data$S)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p2 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= S, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Richness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(6770, 7700), breaks = seq(6770, 7700, 500)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7700, label = "P = 0.295", size = 6)

p2
ggsave("./Alphadiversity/Output/Richness_taxonomic.pdf", p2, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data))


## Pielou_evenness
range(data$Pielou_evenness)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p3 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Pielou_evenness, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Pielou evenness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.842, 0.855), breaks = seq(0.842, 0.855, 0.005)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.855, label = "P = 0.049", size = 6)

p3
ggsave("./Alphadiversity/Output/Pielou_evenness_taxonomic.pdf", p3, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F= 8.23, P = 0.008**

```


## Functional gene diversity

```{r}
design <- read.csv("./Alphadiversity/Data/Metadata_Irrigation.manipulative.exper.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
# Taxonomic a-diversity
data1 <- read.csv("./Alphadiversity/Data/KOs_alpha_diveristy_Rarefied.csv", header = T, row.names = 1)
data2 <- data1[rownames(design),]
data <- cbind(design, data2) # merge design and a-diversity
```


# Plot Functional alpha-diversity

```{r}
## Shannon
range(data$Shannon)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p4 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Shannon, fill = Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth=0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Shannon") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(7.51, 7.57), breaks =seq(7.51, 7.57, 0.03)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7.57, label = "P = 0.356", size = 6)

p4
ggsave("./Alphadiversity/Output/Shannon_function.pdf", p4, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Shannon ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data))


## Observed species
range(data$S)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p5 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= S, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha= 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 2, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Richness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(6770, 7750), breaks = seq(6770, 7750, 500)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 7750, label = "P = 0.514", size = 6)

p5
ggsave("./Alphadiversity/Output/Richness_function.pdf", p5, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(S ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data))


## Pielou_evenness
range(data$Pielou_evenness)
theme_set(theme_bw())
p6 <- ggplot(data, aes(x= Irrigation, y= Pielou_evenness, fill= Irrigation)) +
  geom_violin(linewidth= 0.5, size=0.2, alpha=0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha= 1, width= 0.15, fill= "white") +
  geom_jitter(size= 1.4, width = 0.07, alpha= 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
  theme.plot + xlab(NULL) + ylab("Pielou evenness") + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.842, 0.855), breaks = seq(0.842, 0.855, 0.01)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.855, label = "P = 0.911", size = 6)

p6
ggsave("./Alphadiversity/Output/Pielou evenness_function.pdf", p6, width = 3.5, height = 4)

anova(lmer(Pielou_evenness ~ Irrigation + (1 | State), data = data)) # F=1.38, P=0.244
```
